# The Walrus

> The Walrus Store offers curated branded merchandise including apparel, accessories, and premium merino wool products.

The Walrus Store features a carefully selected collection of branded merchandise, from classic t-shirts and toques to high-quality merino wool socks and tote bags. The store specializes in durable, everyday essentials that reflect The Walrus brand identity and Canadian values.
